items.definition:
relating to journalism
His writing style is very journalistic, focusing on facts and clarity.

at an angle of 90° to a given line, plane, or surface
The two lines are perpendicular to each other.

competent or skilled in doing or using something
She is proficient in several languages.

easy or interesting to read
The book was very readable and engaging.

following a logical order or sequence
The steps must be followed in a sequential order.

relatively expensive and designed for people who are wealthy or of a high social class
They live in an upscale neighborhood.

funny or amusing in a slightly odd or peculiar way
He has a wacky sense of humor.

unyielding
She was adamant that she would not change her mind.

hard but easily broken
The old plastic had become brittle with age.

seeming suspicious or dishonest
His story sounded a bit fishy to me.

(of a person) weak and delicate
The old woman was frail and needed help walking.

relating to or characteristic of a particular generation or generations
There are often generational differences in opinions.

causing horror; dreadful
The weather was horrid all weekend.

not sensible or realistic
His ideas were often impractical but interesting.

without laws or not obeying laws
The town became a lawless place after the sheriff left.

relating to a mayor or the office of mayor
The mayoral election will be held next month.

causing public outrage; disgraceful
The politician's actions were deemed scandalous by the public.

made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis
The design of the building was perfectly symmetrical.

not planned or meant
The new policy had several unintended consequences.

without the physical presence of people to operate it
The drone was an unmanned aerial vehicle.

savagely cruel or uncivilized
The ancient tribe was known for its barbaric customs.

relating to a department
We need to follow the departmental guidelines for this project.

relating to a division
The company announced a new divisional manager for the marketing department.

causing repulsion or horror; grisly
The detective described the gruesome details of the crime scene.

possible to imagine
They faced every imaginable obstacle on their journey.

acting or done without forethought
His impulsive decision to buy the car without checking its history led to problems.

without limits; infinite
The universe seems to be limitless.

able to read and write
It's important for everyone to be literate.

humble; low in status
He started his career in a lowly position but rose to the top.

showing mercy or compassion
The judge was merciful and gave him a lighter sentence.

Attractively unusual or old-fashioned.
The village had many quaint little cottages.

Calm, peaceful, and untroubled.
The lake was perfectly serene at sunrise.

alive but not living in the normal sense
The movie featured a horde of undead creatures rising from their graves.

not limited or controlled
Access to the park is unrestricted during daylight hours.

too unlikely or undesirable to be considered possible
For many, the idea of living without a smartphone is unthinkable.

recommended; sensible
It is advisable to book your tickets in advance, especially during peak season.

curved outward like the exterior of a sphere or circle
A magnifying glass has a convex lens.

disagreeably damp, musty, and typically cold
The old cellar was dark and dank.

depressing; dreary
The weather was dismal, cold and rainy.

creative; imaginative
She has an inventive mind and always comes up with new ideas.

(of food) satisfying the requirements of Jewish law
This restaurant serves only kosher food.

showing aggressive pride in one's masculinity
His macho attitude often alienated people.

relating to an orchestra
The orchestral performance was breathtaking.

relating to a father
He felt a strong paternal instinct towards the child.

absorbed in thought; engrossed
She was too preoccupied to notice him.

inclined to conceal feelings and intentions
He was very secretive about his plans.

having sunk or been submerged
We explored the sunken ship at the bottom of the sea.

not disputed or called into question
He is the undisputed champion of the world.

not conforming to the standards of a profession
His behavior at the meeting was completely unprofessional.

having properties of an alkali
Alkaline batteries are widely used.

very thin, so that the bones can be seen
The stray dog was very bony and needed food.

able to resist the penetration of bullets
The car had bulletproof windows for added security.

trustworthy and reliable
She is a very dependable employee, always completing her tasks on time.

imaginary or not real
The characters in the novel are entirely fictitious.

from the original source
She has firsthand experience of working in a refugee camp.

showy or ostentatious
He drives a flashy sports car.

relating to geology
The area is known for its unique geologic formations.

arriving, coming in
We are expecting an inbound flight from London.

unwilling to accept views, beliefs, or behavior that differ from one's own
He was intolerant of any criticism.

influencing or controlling others in a clever, unfair, or selfish way
He has a very manipulative personality.

Tending to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen.
He has a very pessimistic outlook on the future.

Slow-moving or inactive.
The economy has been sluggish for the past few months.

ready to conform to the authority or will of others
The dog was very submissive to its owner.

not cut or trimmed
The director's uncut version of the film was much longer.
